findings.summary: its section() helper stops at the next heading of any level, so a 'What changed in 2.0' section written with ### subsections (as concepts.md does elsewhere, e.g. '### The stamped release build') is read as empty or truncated and fails the state/v2, gate review, intervention/v2, metrics/v2 and usage-only checks; the brief pins no such flat structure

notes: Every gate was run on the base with vloop task gate and each fails at a behavioural assertion; I also re-ran each with fail() turned into a report to see every assertion, and found no wrong-reason, typo or unbuilt fixture past the first failure. Read back or matched against the pinned text: T3 (status lines 12/16/30 of brief.md), T6 (line 3, column 13), T10 (records.missing order T2/2 T1/1), T11 (first-pass 2/2 and convergence exit 2 versus the wanted 5), T12 (the stub claude), T15 (doctor prints checks and self-hosting in a fresh repository), T16 (link, table and heading matchers), T17 (the real-data comparison already passes base against v2.0.0-beta.2). T1 and T14 judge task-written tests or graders by design (brief Q1 and Q10), so no finding; T14 cannot judge operate-proposes-options beyond well-formedness. T8 asserts case-insensitive trust matching, which holds only on macOS or Windows hosts, the brief's stated gate host. No gate takes longer than 15 s (T1).
